The problem · Google Maps, 30 October 2026

Rated 4.9. Not in Google's top ten.

We searched "accommodation in Aliwal North" on Google Maps. Maison de Blom isn't in the first ten results. Lemon Tree Guest House, also self-catering and also 4.9, is there with 35 reviews. The Jackal shows twice, once as a paid ad.

Google ranks places on how many reviews they have, how recent those reviews are, and how complete the profile is. Your rating is already one of the best in town. What's missing is the number of reviews and a complete profile.

Behind the problem

Three gaps between a 10 out of 10 stay and the next booking.

16
Google reviews

Your guests rate you higher than anyone else in town, but very few of them say so on Google. Kwela has 170 and The Jackal has 152. Nobody asks your guests, so most of them never leave one.

LekkeSlaap: 5.0 from 9
Tonight
How a stopover gets booked

A family on the road searches Google Maps from the car for a bed tonight. They pick from the first few names with the most stars. If you aren't on that list, they never see your four cottages.

Weekend
Contact hours

Your site lists Monday to Friday, 07:00 to 20:00. A traveller who messages on a Saturday asking "do you have a cottage tonight, and can we bring the dog?" needs an answer within minutes, not on Monday.

Why it has to start now

December is when the most travellers pass through.

The December holidays bring the most families through Aliwal North all year, and most of them will look for somewhere to stay on Google Maps. That's the month to be on the first screen, and the month with the most happy guests to ask for a review.

If review requests only start in January, December's guests leave without being asked. So reviews go live in week one, and everything else follows.

You asked · what's the difference between the stands?

Standard or custom: both open your Google review page in one tap.

Standard stand

Tap and review

  • The ReviewTap design, ready to use
  • NFC: a guest taps their phone and your Google review page opens
  • Nothing to set up and no app to download
Custom stand · included for you

Your logo, your colours

  • Printed with the Maison de Blom logo and colours, so it looks like part of the cottage
  • NFC and a QR code, so it works on every phone, old or new
  • Arrives ready to use, with no setup

A stand only works when a guest notices it. The WhatsApp message after checkout is what reaches every guest, including the ones who left early or never sat down in the lounge. That's why we use both together.

How it works · when a stay wasn't perfect

An unhappy guest reaches you before they reach Google.

A guest who rates their stay 3 or lower gets a private message asking what went wrong. You hear about it straight away, and can put it right while it's still fresh.

Every guest is still sent the Google link, because Google doesn't allow review invitations to go only to happy guests. What changes is that you hear about the problem first, privately, and get the chance to fix it.

Guests' names are blurred to protect their privacy.

How it works · already running at Dot Com Restaurant

Answered in a minute. Handed to you when it matters.

A guest asks a simple question on WhatsApp and gets the answer straight away. When they ask for something only a person can decide, it is handed over, and the guest is told when to expect a reply.
